editorial_workflow.subtitle: A small map, not a rewritten original
editorial_workflow.message: Check the passage, not just the search hit.
editorial_workflow.description: Keep the original unchanged, make a short map of meaningful sections, and save distinctive phrases you can search for again. Keep an external locator note with the filename, version and surrounding context. Reopen the same file version and confirm each route before relying on it.
